summary_en: Makuake announced its first dividend of 14 yen per share (178 million yen total) for fiscal year ending September 30, 2026, and authorized share buyback of up to 510,739 shares (4.0% of outstanding shares) for up to 600 million yen through March 31, 2027 via market purchase. The company targets DOE of 3% and aims to exceed mid-teens ROE.
title_en: Notice regarding Decisions on Dividend of Surplus, Share Repurchase, and Stock Option Compensation for Directors (Excluding Audit Committee Members)
translation_en_brief:
Makuake's board of directors approved the company's first dividend and authorized a share buyback program at its October 27, 2026 meeting. The initial dividend is set at 14 yen per share (178 million yen in total) for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026, with an effective date of December 18, 2026. The board also authorized the repurchase of up to 510,739 shares (4.0% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum amount of 600 million yen, to be executed through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 9, 2026 and March 31, 2027.

The company stated that after achieving two consecutive years of profitability through September 2026 and establishing stable free cash flow generation, combined with the transition to a new management structure and the next growth stage, it determined that it could simultaneously continue growth investments and implement shareholder returns. Management stated that current share price levels do not adequately reflect the company's value given its expected business growth and long-term enterprise value prospects.

Regarding capital allocation policy, the company targets a dividend on equity (DOE) of 3% as a baseline while maintaining financial soundness, and aims to exceed mid-teens return on equity (ROE) in the medium term through profit maximization via business growth and strategic share repurchases. The board emphasized that current and future share buybacks are part of this capital efficiency improvement framework.
